audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition with woman/dragon/child symbolism; draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for woman clothed with sun, dragon, child, heavenly conflict, accuser cast down, wilderness protection.

verses.restored: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with sun, moon under her feet, and upon her head crown of twelve stars.

familiar.text: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:

verses.restored: She was pregnant and cries out, travailing and in pain to give birth.

familiar.text: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.

verses.restored: Another sign was seen in heaven: look, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his heads seven crowns.

familiar.text: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.

verses.restored: His tail drags a third of stars of heaven and casts them to earth. The dragon stood before woman about to give birth, so that when she bore, he might devour her child.

familiar.text: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.

verses.restored: She bore a male child, who is about to shepherd all nations with iron rod; her child was caught up to the Divine and to his throne.

familiar.text: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.

verses.restored: The woman fled into wilderness, where she has a place prepared by the Divine, so they might nourish her there one thousand two hundred sixty days.

familiar.text: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.

verses.restored: War happened in heaven: Michael and his messengers fought with dragon, and dragon and his messengers fought,

familiar.text: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,

verses.restored: but he did not prevail, nor was place found for them any longer in heaven.

familiar.text: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.

verses.restored: The great dragon was cast down, the ancient serpent, called slanderer and adversarial one, the one misleading whole inhabited world; he was cast to earth, and his messengers with him.

familiar.text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

verses.restored: I heard great voice in heaven saying: Now came salvation/healing and power and reign of our Divine and authority of his Messiah, because accuser of our siblings was cast down, the one accusing them before our Divine day and night.

familiar.text: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.

verses.restored: They conquered him through blood/life of Lamb and through word of their witness, and they did not love their life/soul even until death.

familiar.text: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.

verses.restored: Because of this rejoice, heavens and those dwelling in them. Woe to earth and sea, because the slanderer/adversary came down to you having great rage, knowing he has little season.

familiar.text: Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.

verses.restored: When dragon saw he was cast to earth, he pursued the woman who bore the male child.

familiar.text: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.

verses.restored: To the woman were given two wings of great eagle, so she might fly into wilderness to her place, where she is nourished a season and seasons and half season, away from face of serpent.

familiar.text: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

verses.restored: The serpent cast from his mouth water like river after the woman, so that she might be swept away by river.

familiar.text: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.

verses.restored: The earth helped the woman, opening its mouth and swallowing the river that dragon cast from his mouth.

familiar.text: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.

verses.restored: And dragon was enraged against the woman and went away to make war with the rest of her seed, those keeping commands of Divine and holding witness of Jesus.

familiar.text: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.

translation_notes: Woman/child/dragon are symbolic, drawing Israel/Messianic/community imagery; avoid reducing the woman to only one referent.
The accuser is defeated by Lamb-life and witness, not by domination.
Wilderness is protection and nourishment, not abandonment.
safety_note: Do not use dragon/serpent imagery to demonize people. It symbolizes accuser/deceiver power opposed to faithful witness and vulnerable birth.
